leads.title: Law of 28 November 2006 on equal treatment (Loi du 28 novembre 2006 sur l'égalité de traitement)
leads.documents: Prohibits direct and indirect discrimination based on sexual orientation and 'change of sex' (within sex) in employment, education, social security, healthcare, provision of goods and services; basis for hate-crime aggravating factor recognition
leads.detail: Article 1 quoted in text; French/Luxembourgish/German titles given; No URL visible in provided text

leads.title: Luxembourg Penal Code Article 372
leads.documents: Sets age of consent at 16 regardless of sexual orientation or gender; documents decriminalisation history for same-sex sexual activity
leads.detail: Cited as decriminalised 1794, increased to 18 for same-sex in 1971 by addition of article 372, repealed 1992; No URL visible

leads.title: Law of 1 November 2004 on partnership (partenariat / Partnerschaft)
leads.documents: Recognises same-sex partnerships granting many benefits of marriage, based on French PACS model

leads.title: June 2014 Same-Sex Marriage and Adoption Law, effective 1 January 2015
leads.documents: Enables same-sex marriage and full joint adoption rights; lesbian couples access to IVF and medically assisted insemination
leads.detail: Passed Parliament 56 votes to 4 in June 2014, took effect 1 January 2015; No URL visible

leads.title: Administrative Court of Luxembourg - January 2019 surrogacy citizenship ruling
leads.documents: Enforcement case: reversed Justice Minister Félix Braz decision denying citizenship to one twin born in California via surrogacy to same-sex couple; held both parents on California birth documents must be recognized
leads.detail: Minister granted citizenship to one boy May 2017, refused other December; suit filed, court reversed January 2019; No URL visible

leads.title: Law of 10 August 2018 on legal sex change (self-determination)
leads.documents: Allows transgender people to change legal gender by application to Ministry of Justice on basis of self-determination with no surgery, sterilization, divorce or medical treatment required; minors including under age 5 can apply with guardian consent
leads.detail: Council of Government approved bill 12 May 2017, submitted 31 May, approved Parliament 57-3 on 25 July 2018, Council of State consent to skip second vote 27 July 2018, promulgated by Grand Duke 10 August, published official journal 12 September, effective 16 September 2018; No URL visible

leads.title: Luxembourg LGBT Action Plan 2018-2023
leads.documents: Government rights machinery pledge to ensure inclusive education for LGBT students, combat violence/harassment/discrimination, guarantee equal treatment in healthcare and employment, assure equality of transgender and intersex individuals
leads.detail: Government of Luxembourg plan cited 2018-2023; No URL visible

leads.title: ILGA-Europe 2021 ranking
leads.documents: Institutional human-rights assessment ranking Luxembourg third in the European Union for LGBT rights protection
leads.detail: 2021 ILGA-Europe ranking cited; No URL visible

leads.title: Eurobarometer 2019 survey
leads.documents: Public tolerance/enforcement climate: 87% of Luxembourgers believed gay, lesbian and bisexual people should enjoy same rights as heterosexual people, 85% supported same-sex marriage

leads.title: Eurobarometer 2023 survey
leads.documents: Public tolerance climate: 84% thought same-sex marriage should be allowed throughout Europe, 86% agreed there is nothing wrong in a sexual relationship between two persons of same sex
